terms.gloss: the rosary, its beads and its prayers
evidence: M-O s.v. objects: rosary (beads), after Maigne and Ducrue (1784)
terms.comment: A Western devotion: a string of beads in five decades, for the Hail Mary. Classically rosārium is a rose garden (rosārium Paestī, Mart. 5.37.9). The Orthodox use the prayer rope instead.

evidence: M-O s.v. objects: rosary (beads), after Erasmus

sources: Lewis & Short: rosarius · Lewis & Short: sphaerula · Lewis & Short: precatorius
